verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a deliberate secrets system: additive SecretRefs keep supported credentials out of plaintext config, backed by a shared secret store, runtime snapshots, and safe one-way scrubbing. Per-tenant cells also isolate credentials from one another. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that keys are kept out of or redacted from chat/session history and logs, SecretRef coverage limited to 'supported credentials' with no full list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scrubbing behavior.
